Hint: Get camo defense.|Beginning of Wave 22 ([[Pre-MEGA Modes|Pre-MEGA]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hidden Boss''' is a large and fast boss that appears in [[Casual Mode|Casual]], [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]], [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]], [[Molten Mode|Molten]], Base Arena [[PVP]] and Molten Arena [[PVP]] modes. It also appeared in [[The Classic Event]]. It has decent amount of health and decent speed. Towers must have hidden detection to target the '''Hidden Boss'''. The '''Hidden Boss''' can be spawned from the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death in the [[Easy Mode|Easy]] and [[Legacy Molten Mode|Legacy Molten]] modes. ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the '''Hidden Boss''' is a large humanoid with a waist, lower arms and lower legs in its rig. It is faceless and has a translucent dark grey body with a slime-like texture. It wears a black blindfold and cloak with a cape and sleeves, as well as black spiked braces with chains attached. It emits black smoke from its body. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Hidden Boss''' was a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It had a translucent black body and wears a black cape, cloak and sleeves along with a grey blindfold. }} |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current version of the legacy '''Hidden Boss''' has a translucent black skin and a black pebble torso and legs. It wears a black cape and a large pair of translucent black horns with a shorter pair behind them. It has an emissive white scar on its face with two streaks leaking on the right side of it. |Current (Enemies Beta) |The current [[Enemies Beta]] version of the legacy '''Hidden Boss''' is a large humanoid with a waist in its rig. It has a translucent black body and wears a black cape, cloak and sleeves along with a grey blindfold. |Version 3 |The third version of the legacy '''Hidden Boss''' had translucent black skin and a black pebble torso and legs. It wore a black cape and had a large pair of translucent black horns with a shorter pair behind them. It had a drooling zombie face with glowing white eyes. |Version 2 |The second version of the legacy '''Hidden Boss''' had translucent grey skin and a dark navy granite torso and legs. It wore a black cape and had a large pair of translucent black horns with a shorter pair behind them. It had a drooling zombie face with glowing white eyes. Grey smoke also came out of its torso. |Version 1 |The first version of the legacy '''Hidden Boss''' had translucent grey skin and a translucent dark grey torso and legs. It had a large pair of translucent black horns with a shorter pair behind them. It had a drooling zombie face with glowing white eyes. White particles also came out of its torso. Its walking animation had it hovering above the path. }} }} ==Strategy== *Towers with decent DPS and hidden detection, like the [[Minigunner]], [[Hunter]] and [[Crook Boss]] can be used to deal with it. **Early-game towers like the [[Cowboy]], [[Soldier]], [[Militant]] or [[Assassin]] can also be used. *Towers like the [[Ace Pilot]] or [[Firework Technician]] can be used to grant hidden detection to towers that do not normally have it, like the [[Ranger]], [[Mortar]] or [[Toxic Gunner]]. *While some splash damage towers like the [[Demoman]] and [[Mortar]] cannot target '''Hidden Bosses''', they can hit them through splash damage, if another detectable enemy is near the '''Hidden Boss'''. **This is very useful for towers which have a large explosion range, such as the [[Mortar]]. **The [[Rocketeer]] can be effective against the '''Hidden Boss''' because of its hidden detection and high DPS. *You can use the [[Frost Blaster]], [[Freezer]] and [[Warden]] to slow the '''Hidden Boss''' down. **While [[Sledger]] and [[Tesla]] do not have hidden detection, they can still indirectly hit the '''Hidden Boss''' if a detectable enemy is near it, though this should not be relied on as its quite inconsistent. **Due to the '''Hidden Boss's''' size, various forms of stalling like freeze or knockback will be less effective on it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants LegacyHiddenBossIconIG.png|Legacy '''Hidden Boss''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *When the [[Uber Mystery]] was in the game, it had a chance of spawning the '''Hidden Boss''', upon its death, in [[Golden Mode|Golden]] and [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] modes. *The current appearance of the '''Hidden Boss''' is very similar to the original version of the [[Shadow Boss]]. *On some devices, the '''Hidden Boss''' may have transparent skin instead of black skin, with certain graphics settings. *The cape used by the legacy '''Hidden Boss''' is a re-textured version of the {{RLinkC|215748322|Guardian of the Night Cape}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *Multiple '''Hidden Bosses''' can be seen as a chess piece in the [[Chess Board]] map, representing the Bishop chess piece. **One of the '''Hidden Bosses''' can also be seen hanging on the chess piece. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''14 June 2019''' -
